meta.name: programming-fundamentals
meta.description: Core programming concepts from variables through recursion. Covers data types (integers, floats, strings, booleans, arrays, objects), variables and scope (lexical, dynamic, block, function, global), control flow (conditionals, loops, pattern matching), functions (parameters, return values, closures, higher-order functions), recursion (base cases, call stack, tail recursion, mutual recursion), type systems (static vs dynamic, strong vs weak, type inference, generics), and error handling (exceptions, Result types, defensive programming). Use when teaching, reviewing, or diagnosing issues with fundamental programming constructs.
